stem: A 12-year-old with migraine asks what non-drug measure may help immediately at home during an attack while awaiting review if needed, which option is best?

options.text: Quiet, cool, dark room and sleep
Bright room stimulation to stay awake
Complete fasting until the headache resolves

explanation: Quiet, cool, dark room and sleep is the recommended non-drug measure for acute migraine relief at home.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a quiet, cool, dark environment with sleep is specifically named as an acute non-pharmacological migraine measure.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because bright stimulation and staying awake are the opposite of the recommended calm, dark environment.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because fasting is not the acute home measure described for migraine relief.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because strenuous exercise is not used to treat an acute migraine attack.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because frequent screen use does not match the recommended low-stimulation approach.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
